biggest_catch: TWO separate $300 direct deposits plus 15 debit purchases in 60 days — and you need a utility bill matching your ID's address just to open.
catches: New Alltru members only — existing members (including joint signers) and anyone who closed an Alltru membership within 12 months are excluded.
Apply by 12/31/2026 using offer code BENEFITS300 (online, by phone, or in branch).

Within 60 days of account opening: a) be a new member, b) open a new checking account, c) two direct deposits of $300 each (paycheck, pension, Social Security, or government benefits), d) enroll in online banking and e-statements, e) 15 debit card purchases.
Bonus paid into the primary savings account 15 days after the qualifying behaviors are met; account must have a positive balance and be in good standing.
Only one cash bonus per household.
Field-of-membership restrictions; a valid ID and a utility bill with the same address as the ID are required to open.
The credit union may amend or cancel the offer at any time.

steps: Apply by 12/31/2026 using offer code BENEFITS300 — online, by phone, or in branch — as a new Alltru member (have a valid ID and a utility bill with the same address as your ID).
Within 60 days of account opening: receive two direct deposits of $300 each from an employer or outside agency (paycheck, pension, Social Security, or government benefits).
Enroll in online banking and e-statements within the same 60 days.
Complete at least 15 debit card purchases within the same 60 days.
Keep the account in good standing with a balance greater than zero; the $300 bonus is deposited into the primary savings account 15 days after the qualifying behaviors are met.
